newsitem.title: USA: USAir earnings, passenger traffic on the rise.
newsitem.headline: USAir earnings, passenger traffic on the rise.

text.p: USAir Group Inc. said Monday its profits for the third quarter rose 57 percent to $67.7 million as total traffic jumped 6.3 percent.
The Arlington-based airline said its per-share earnings were 69 cents, well above Wall Street analysts' expectations of 49 cents.

In addition to the rise in overall airline traffic, USAir said third quarter international traffic was up 56.6 percent, reflecting new service between Philadelphia and Munich, Germany, Rome and Madrid, Spain.

"While the industry generally continues to benefit from positive economic conditions, our employees also have done much to begin an across-the-board improvement in product quality," company Chairman Stephen Wolf said in a statement.

Wolf said USAir has been profitable five of the last six quarters. He said without provisions for a profit-sharing agreement with employees who previously took pay cuts, the company would have had a profit of $108.5 million for the quarter.
Following this year's payouts, the 1992 profit-sharing agreement will be completed.
USAir was up 62.5 cents on the New York Stock Exchange at $16.875 in afternoon trading.
